slides.caption: The smallest gesture can echo forever.

post_caption:
Small things. Quiet things. Things done without witness or fanfare. They don't feel like anything while you're living them—which is precisely why they matter. The stone doesn't choose where the ripples go. It only chooses to be thrown. The water decides the rest.

What do you think - are you more concerned with the stone you're holding, or the ripples you can't control?
